title: Amazon Bedrock
description: Models on Amazon Bedrock, Claude, Nova and the open models included: Tomrade uses the credentials the AWS CLI already holds, or a Bedrock API key, and talks to Bedrock's Converse API in your region.

why.exec: Runs the AWS CLI (aws configure export-credentials, aws configure get region) to use the credentials and region you already set up for it, so you need not paste a key. It runs nothing else.
